text: The folding phone has Touch ID
full-pick-text: The folding phone has Touch ID. But also offers a new version of Face ID powered by just cameras. Apple says this is powered by Apple Intelligence and is a beta. They publish information later that shows it's less secure than standard Face ID, but close enough to Touch ID.
